WITH sex_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN 'Missing'
      WHEN TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN 'Blank'
      ELSE p.SEX
    END as sex,
    COUNT(*) as exam_count
  FROM Patient p
  INNER JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  GROUP BY CASE 
    WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN 'Missing'
    WHEN TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN 'Blank'
    ELSE p.SEX
  END
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    s.sex,
    s.exam_count,
    SUM(s.exam_count) OVER () as total,
    COUNT(*) OVER () as num_groups,
    s.exam_count * 1.0 / SUM(s.exam_count) OVER () as share,
    SUM(s.exam_count) OVER () * 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () as per_sex_avg
  FROM sex_counts s
)
SELECT 
  sex,
  exam_count,
  ROUND(share, 4) as share,
  ROUND(exam_count - per_sex_avg, 2) as distance_above_avg
FROM stats
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Above Average Combined' as sex,
  SUM(exam_count) as exam_count,
  ROUND(AVG(share), 4) as share,
  ROUND(AVG(exam_count - per_sex_avg), 2) as distance_above_avg
FROM stats
WHERE exam_count > per_sex_avg
ORDER BY CASE WHEN sex = 'Above Average Combined' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, sex
